meta.title: Terms of Use
meta.description: Usage rules for the FREE-ARENA.RO platform and community.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: FREE-ARENA.RO is a competitive gaming community. These rules keep the experience fair for players, staff, and partners.

administrator.title: Community administrator
administrator.body: The platform is administered by the FREE-ARENA.RO team. For account, server, moderation, or content issues, use the official contact: {contactEmail}.

access.title: Platform access
access.body: You can use the site for information about servers, TeamSpeak, Discord, tournaments, and community services. Future account, VIP, or admin features may require authentication and additional rules.

conduct.title: Community conduct
conduct.body: Cheats, abuse, spam, impersonation, extreme toxicity, and attempts to disrupt services are not accepted. Staff may restrict access when community safety requires it.

servers.title: Servers and external services
servers.body: Server status, Steam links, TeamSpeak, and Discord depend on external services. FREE-ARENA.RO shows clean fallbacks when a service does not respond.

limits.title: Limitations
limits.body: Site content is provided for information and community coordination. Features marked as future work are not commercial commitments until the real backend is launched.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For reports, questions, or community requests, write to {contactEmail}. Include enough detail so staff can verify the situation quickly.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How FREE-ARENA.RO handles minimal data used for the site, servers, and community.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: FREE-ARENA.RO keeps data limited to what is needed for platform operation and community protection.

administrator.title: Who administers the data
administrator.body: The platform is administered by the FREE-ARENA.RO team. For questions about data or content, contact us at {contactEmail}.

data.title: Data collected
data.body: The public site may process basic technical data such as IP address, user-agent, language, timestamp, and request logs. Server integrations display only public game and TeamSpeak status.

usage.title: How data is used
usage.body: Technical data is used for security, diagnostics, uptime, anti-abuse protection, and experience improvements. We do not sell community data.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: The platform does not require tracking cookies for the current public features. If analytics or login features are introduced later, this page will be updated before use.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: Technical logs are kept only as long as needed for security and operation. Account, VIP, or admin data will receive clear rules when the real backend is launched.

contact.title: Rights and contact
contact.body: For questions, corrections, or data requests, write to {contactEmail}. We will handle reasonable requests transparently.
